text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's time for my second summer camp with Smart Falcon, and…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her motivation levels are through the roof!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Duh! The ocean means the beach, and the beach means sand!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: And sand means Silence Suzuka of the Sand!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon's new nickname is becoming increasingly widespread among fans, and she seems well aware of it.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: If I'm going to borrow her name, I need to get even stronger so I can do it justice!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Suzuka's strength is what allowed her to become a star and capture everyone's heart.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: So I wanna be super-duper strong, just like my namesake!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: So strong I can… uh, I can… Let's see…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: So strong I can part the seas with a single step!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: This summer camp, I'm going to become a force of nature!
